SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") 
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."avgscrmath" > 560
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded';

SELECT s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s."cdscode" = sa."cds"
WHERE sa."numtsttakr" > 0
ORDER BY (sa."numge1500"::NUMERIC / sa."numtsttakr") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s."sname", s."avgscrwrite", sc."charternum"
FROM "satscores" s
JOIN "schools" sc ON s."cds" = sc."cdscode"
WHERE s."avgscrwrite" > 499
  AND sc."charternum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT adm_name, district, cnt
FROM (
    SELECT adm_name, district, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY district ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT "admfname1" AS adm_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
        UNION ALL
        SELECT "admfname2" AS adm_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
        UNION ALL
        SELECT "admfname3" AS adm_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
    ) AS names
    GROUP BY adm_name, district
) AS ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 2;
SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.mailstreet = 'PO Box 1040' AND s.school = 'Youth Authority School';

SELECT s."school", s."ncesschool"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
GROUP BY s."school", s."ncesschool"
ORDER BY MAX(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ss."numtsttakr") AS average_test_takers
FROM "satscores" ss
JOIN "schools" s ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."county" = 'Fresno'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s."opendate"::date) = 1980;

SELECT s."gsoffered"
FROM schools s
WHERE s."longitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s."longitude") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", s."street" AS "postal_street_address"
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s ON sc."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE sc."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc."avgscrmath" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s."phone", s."ext"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST
OFFSET 332 LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."avgscrmath", s."cname"
FROM "satscores" s
ORDER BY (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."street", s."city", s."zip", s."state"
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s ON sc."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE sc."numtsttakr" > 0
ORDER BY (sc."numge1500"::NUMERIC / sc."numtsttakr") ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", ss."avgscrwrite", s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."cdscode" = ss."cds"
WHERE (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '1991-12-31')
   OR (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate"::date < DATE '2000-01-01');

SELECT
  f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS "free_rate"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 ILIKE '%Kacey%'
  AND s.admlname1 ILIKE '%Gibson%';

SELECT s."county", s."school", s."closeddate"
FROM "schools" s
WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
  AND s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."county" = (
    SELECT s2."county"
    FROM "schools" s2
    WHERE s2."statustype" = 'Closed'
      AND s2."closeddate" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s2."county"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY s."closeddate" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded'
  AND s."opendate" > '2000-01-01';

SELECT f."District Code", (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100) AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 ILIKE '%Alusine%';

SELECT s.city, f."Low Grade", s.school
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.state = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.latitude ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.admemail1
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", s."doctype"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN frpm f2 ON s2."cdscode" = f2."cdscode"
    WHERE s2."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s."admfname1", s."admlname1"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
ORDER BY sat."numge1500" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.charter = 0
  AND s.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) < 0.18;

SELECT s.city, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND f."Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND f."High Grade" = '8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.city
ORDER BY s.city ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."side" IS NULL
ORDER BY c."convertedmanacost" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."id") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" ILIKE '%John Avon%'
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."originaltype" = 'Summon - Angel'
  AND c."subtypes" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."subtypes" <> 'Angel';

SELECT c."id" AS card_id, COUNT(*) AS black_border_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."bordercolor" = 'black'
GROUP BY c."id";

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE (c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*')
  AND c."promotypes" = 'arenaleague'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 3;
SELECT "keywords" FROM "cards" WHERE "name" = 'Angel of Mercy';
SELECT c."convertedmanacost" FROM "cards" c WHERE c."name" = 'Ancestor''s Chosen';

SELECT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
ORDER BY s."basesetsize" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" = 'Aaron Miller'
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c."originalreleasedate", l."format"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."rarity" = 'mythic'
  AND l."status" = 'legal'
  AND c."originalreleasedate" = (
    SELECT MIN(c2."originalreleasedate")
    FROM "cards" c2
    WHERE c2."rarity" = 'mythic'
  )
ORDER BY l."format" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT st."translation"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "set_translations" st ON st."setcode" = c."setcode"
WHERE c."name" = 'Tendo Ice Bridge'
  AND st."language" = 'French';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese' AND s."type" = 'expansion')::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese'), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON s."code" = st."setcode";

SELECT c."name", l."status"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."types" = 'Artifact'
  AND c."side" IS NULL
  AND l."format" = 'vintage';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."id") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
JOIN "rulings" r ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'premodern'
  AND r."text" = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c."side" IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c."isstoryspotlight" = 1 AND c."istextless" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(c."id"), 0)::NUMERIC,
    2
  ) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."code") AS set_count
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "set_translations" st ON st."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese'
  AND (s."mtgocode" IS NULL OR s."mtgocode" = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."id") AS rare_legal_abundance_enchantment_count
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."rarity" = 'rare'
  AND c."types" LIKE '%Enchantment%'
  AND c."name" = 'Abundance'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal';

SELECT c.id, r.text, c.hascontentwarning
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist LIKE '%Stephen Daniele%';

SELECT DISTINCT s."name"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE c."name" = 'Angel of Mercy'
  AND s."mtgocode" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
WHERE s."type" = 'commander'
ORDER BY s."totalsetsize" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c."name", r."text", CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = 1 THEN 'has missing or degraded properties and values' ELSE 'does not have missing or degraded properties and values' END AS "property_status"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "rulings" r ON c."uuid" = r."uuid"
WHERE c."artist" = 'Jim Pavelec';

SELECT c."name", l."format"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE s."name" = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal';

SELECT
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = 0 THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(c."id"), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'commander'
  AND l."status" = 'legal';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c."isnonfoilonly" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "set_translations" st
    ON st."setcode" = c."setcode"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."language" = 'French')::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::NUMERIC) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "foreign_data" c
WHERE c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*';

SELECT DISTINCT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "cards" c ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE s."isforeignonly" = 1
  AND c."hasfoil" = 1
  AND fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."text" ILIKE '%French%')::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
WHERE c."isstoryspotlight" = 1;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT DISTINCT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c."artist" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')
ORDER BY c."artist" ASC NULLS FIRST;
